subject: shiny kills app after a while

messages.author: 634fcb21cb4f65a1
messages.subject: shiny kills app after a while
parts:
Hi Guys

We have some shiny apps that take few minutes to start because of the amount of data that is read into memory. When they are not used for a while, I believe shiny kills them. Ideally this would be a good strategy for efficient resource utilization but in our case given the start time we want to disable this feature. Can we do this in the latest version of shiny server..

Thanks!
-Abhi

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny kills app after a while
parts:
You want to set app_idle_timeout for that app to a large number of seconds.

If your startup times are long enough you might also find that Shiny Server is giving up on the process while it's still trying to load--you can control that threshold with app_init_timeout.

Thanks!

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: shiny kills app after a while
parts:
Hi Abhi,

You can set the app_idle_timeout to `0` to disable the idle timeout altogether. Init you are not currently able to turn off, but you can set it to an hour or more if you prefer.

Jeff
